items.title: Bill Huntington and Charlie Suhor Interview, 1992-04-06
items.q: George Gerard, there was no bass, George Gerard came up and started playing on the bass, right?

ctx.x: Let's get back to something that we mentioned but didn't really go into any detail on it, and that is that integration of the New Orleans Jazz Club stage. You want to give us some detail on who was on that session?

Yeah, I can tell you more exactly how I felt than I could tell you. I can tell you every person who was involved, but I can tell you how I felt. Like I said, by the time, I think I was about 15, I had done the Ken Collier session, so I was probably just about 16. And I remember feeling an awful lot of resentment against what I felt was the white, jazz establishment in the city. That, I mean, being a kid had a lot to do with this because I didn't understand the infrastructure behind the segregation laws and so on.…
